description: This file is a Java interface named ShoppingCartCalculationService, which declares methods for calculating the total cost and subtotal of a ShoppingCart object within an e-commerce system. It defines two overloaded methods for price calculation, taking different parameters, and includes relevant documentation and imports.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to calculate shopping cart totals, including subtotals and total prices, for an e-commerce system.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total and subtotal for a ShoppingCart, considering Customer, Store, and Language, returning an OrderTotalSummary. Throws ServiceException on failure. Used when customer context is needed.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total and subtotal for a ShoppingCart, given Store and Language context, returning an OrderTotalSummary. Throws ServiceException on failure. Used when customer context is not necessary.
